items.title: Web Development
items.short: Business websites, web apps and e-commerce for companies launching online or improving an existing site.
items.description: Your website is often the first conversation someone has with your business. Make it clear, useful, and memorable.

intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / WEB DEVELOPMENT
intro.heading: Website development.
intro.description: Custom website development for businesses launching online, improving an existing site, or planning a web application. We discuss content, responsive design, functionality, and integrations before agreeing the project scope.

offers.title: Business websites
offers.description: Responsive websites for businesses that need to explain their services and receive enquiries. Agree page content, navigation and enquiry journeys, together with the browser and device checks needed before launch.

offers.title: Web applications
offers.description: Browser-based applications for defined business workflows. User journeys, data, account access and third-party integrations are scoped before development and testing.

offers.title: E-commerce
offers.description: Online shopping experiences shaped around your products, catalogue, checkout, payment provider, and fulfilment needs. E-commerce features are quoted to the agreed scope.

items.planning: Share your pages, content and integration needs. We discuss browser and device checks, deployment and separately scoped maintenance. Agree hosting accounts, access, ownership and handover requirements in the project scope. SEO is scoped separately.
items.detailsMuted: A clear plan for your site.
detailsDescription: Business websites, web applications and online stores.
Features and integrations are agreed before development.

items.title: App Development
items.short: Android, iOS and cross-platform app planning, UI/UX and development around your users and core features.
items.description: Bring your idea closer to the people who need it with a focused, intuitive mobile experience.

intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / APP DEVELOPMENT
intro.heading: Mobile app development.
intro.description: App development for Android, iOS, and cross-platform projects. We work through your users, essential features, UI/UX, data requirements, and release priorities before defining the first version.

offers.title: iOS & Android
offers.description: Android and iOS app projects are planned around your audience and required features. Agree target devices, testing needs and store-submission responsibilities. Android projects can include Play Store submission assistance within the agreed scope.

offers.title: Cross-platform development
offers.description: Consider a shared approach for Android and iOS when it fits your features, integrations, and maintenance needs. We discuss trade-offs before choosing the development approach.

offers.title: User experience & interface
offers.description: Map core user journeys, screen layouts, navigation, and interactions. Clear UI/UX helps people understand what to do and gives development a practical foundation.

items.planning: Share target platforms, screens, login and backend requirements. Define device testing, acceptance checks, store submission, source-code access and handover in the scope. Android submission assistance and post-launch maintenance are discussed to suit the project; no store approval is guaranteed.
detailsDescription: Choose platforms around the people using your app.
Agree the screens, data and integrations for the first release.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.short: SEO, social media content and campaign planning for businesses coordinating their digital presence.
items.description: Build a digital presence that connects your business with the right audience through a clear, coordinated strategy.

intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / DIGITAL MARKETING
intro.heading: Digital marketing.
intro.description: Bring social media marketing, search engine optimization, and campaign planning into one discussion. We start with your audience, current website, available content, and business priorities.

offers.title: Search engine optimization
offers.description: Keyword research, on-page optimization, technical website reviews, and content planning. Explore our SEO services to understand the scope and priorities for your website.

offers.title: Social media marketing
offers.description: Plan relevant platforms, a content calendar, post design, captions, and reporting. Explore how our social media marketing services fit your business and available content.

offers.title: Campaign strategy
offers.description: Agree campaign goals, messaging, channels and the measures used to review progress. A plan can coordinate SEO and social media work; any advertising execution requires a separate, confirmed scope.

items.planning: Share your audience, existing channels and available content. We agree campaign goals, deliverables and reporting measures. Campaign planning does not by itself include paid ad management. Rankings, reach and enquiries are not guaranteed.
detailsDescription: Coordinate your channels around one set of priorities.
Choose specialist SEO or social media support as needed.
